notes.title: Patch 1.0.4 Notes
notes.content:
[p]- Fixed a bug where if you failed to kill the second boss (appears in higher difficulties), his HP bar would flicker in the next wave.
- Deleted the blue fire explosions of the final boss after his death.
- Increased the damage of the Tornado skill.
- Reduced the second boss's HP (appears in higher difficulties).
[/p]

- Reduced the second boss's HP (appears in higher difficulties).

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3 Notes:
notes.content:
- Reduced the sound of the tornado

- Fixed an issue where the Sound Setting did not work properly

- Balanced combination skills

- Changed the color of the boss’s fireball to avoid confusion with the player’s fireball.

- Various minor fixes

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2 notes
notes.content:
- Added music to the game menu

- If the game window is not focused, music will be paused

- Fixed a bug where the Total Damage text was sometimes not shown correctly
